{c_important}Bosses{/c} in {c_important}Nightmare Dungeons{/c} gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} and have a chance to drop an {c_legendary}Escalation Sigil{/c} when slain.

{c_legendary}Escalation Sigils{/c} can only appear in Torment+ difficulty.
